incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: KMS decrypt error spike detected for prod-region-1 (alert=kms.decrypt.5xx.rate)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-78421 opened · Severity: P1 · Services: redwood-kms-service · Affected: prod-region-1 · Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-78421
marta: acked on call — jumping in. seeing a bunch of 429 / 404 decrypt errors in logs, and some "KeyNotFound" in the HSM paths. :thinking_face:
sanjay: I see the same: metrics show decrypt failure rate spiked at ~10:07 UTC. CPU on kms-proxy nodes normal, but HSM pool returning 429 bursts. Logs:
```
ERROR [kms-client] decrypt failed: 429 ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded for key arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/abcd-ef01-prod-rot-2026
context: attempt=2 latency=94ms
ERROR [hsm-adapter] decrypt returned KeyNotFound for slot 3: slot key id mismatch
```
kevin: quick assessment — this aligns with yesterday's rotation batch for "prod-rot-2026" that started at 06:00 UTC. Some hosts still have cached envelope keys pointing at the old key id. When request fans out, HSM rejects with KeyNotFound and KMS layer responds 429 on retries.
lia: Customer impact: auth/token decrypts for generation requests failing intermittently; most traffic is OK but high-QPS customers see elevated errors and retries, increased latencies. Working on rolling mitigation.
marta: Early mitigation plan:
- pause rotation rollout for remaining nodes
- add a short-term retry/backoff tweak to reduce fanout on 429s
- pin old key id on the failing nodes (rollback point) while we reconcile HSM slot mapping
- open incident ticket (INC-78421) and notify support + account teams
Can someone run the rollback pin on the regional rotation job?
oncall-runner: running rollback pin now — hitting orchestration API:
```
POST /ops/kms/rotation/pin
{
  "region": "prod-region-1",
  "key_id": "abcd-ef01-prod-rot-2026",
  "reason": "emergency-pause-decrypt-failures"
}
```
oncall-runner: response: 202 Accepted — rotation jobs paused for prod-region-1. Scheduling reconciliation job.
sanjay: while that runs, I'm going to adjust the kms-client local retry to add jitter and exponential backoff + limit fanout concurrency from 16 -> 4 for 15min. patch:
```
# /etc/service/config/kms-client.conf
retry.max_attempts=3
retry.base_delay_ms=100
retry.max_concurrency=4
```
kevin: deployed the concurrency change to the proxy fleet in prod-region-1. Watching metrics.
marta: support update draft to customers: "We've identified an issue related to a key rotation in prod-region-1 leading to intermittent decrypt failures. We paused the rotation and applied mitigations; we'll provide updates every 30 minutes." Posting to incidents channel.
pagerduty-bot: INC-78421 has been acknowledged by marta.
lia: quick note on root cause hypothesis: rotation orchestrator sent new key reference before HSM slot mapping completed on some appliances and retries caused HSM rate limits. We need to add a safe-window in the rotation state machine to wait for HSM confirm.
marta: agreed. long-term fix: rotation orchestration -> confirm HSM slot commit -> cache invalidation + gradual traffic shift. Add an automated canary traffic step.
oncall-runner: reconciliation job completed — 62 hosts reconciled, 4 still failing KeyNotFound (they're on older image with missing hsm driver). I've opened a fix task to bootstrap driver and re-run.
kevin: metric update: decrypt 5xx rate down ~78% after pause and concurrency throttle. Latency back to baseline for most customers. Still monitoring top 5 accounts.
sanjay: I've scheduled a temporary circuit-breaker: if decrypt 5xx > 1% for >5min, route to secondary key store (read-only fallback) to avoid total failures. Implemented as routing rule in control plane.
```
# control-plane snippet
if(metrics.decrypt_5xx_rate(region)==>0.01 for 5m) {
  route.decrypt_requests -> fallback_kms("prod-secondary")
}
```
lia: paging escalation note: PagerDuty incident still open. If we hit >2% 5xx we'll escalate to SRE lead and paging to infra oncall.
marta: thank you everyone. I'll own postmortem and schedule 1-hour blameless review tomorrow. Action items from this thread:
- (marta) draft postmortem and timeline
- (sanjay) add safe-window + HSM confirm in rotation orchestrator
- (kevin) finish driver bootstrap and re-run reconciliation for 4 hosts
- (lia) customer comms + account outreach
- (oncall-runner) monitor metrics and revert throttles after stable
Please add anything I missed.
kevin: logging note: archive relevant decrypt traces to S3 path s3://redwood-incidents/INC-78421/traces/
marta: closing notes for now — metrics look stable, support notified, rotation paused. Will update in 30m or earlier if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: INC-78421 status: acknowledged · responders: marta · priority: P1
incident-bot: Incident thread closed in channel (ops state: mitigated) — follow-up: schedule postmortem doc and RCA tag: kms-rotation-hsm-throttle
